raw.rss_scope: Whole isolated process, including model construction, runtime, arrays and optimizer
raw.initialization_scope: Model construction, differentiation, export and selected execution sessions
raw.initializer_scope: Logical top-level initializer bytes for each execution session
raw.input_view_scope: Host data-input preparation; adapter preparation is included in forward
raw.exchange_scope: CPU NumPy input views; input snapshots and parameter/output views are included in execution boundaries

optimized.rss_scope: Whole isolated process, including model construction, runtime, arrays and optimizer
optimized.initialization_scope: Model construction, differentiation, export and selected execution sessions
optimized.initializer_scope: Logical top-level initializer bytes for each execution session
optimized.input_view_scope: Host data-input preparation; adapter preparation is included in forward
optimized.exchange_scope: CPU NumPy input views; input snapshots and parameter/output views are included in execution boundaries

pytorch.rss_scope: Whole isolated process, including model construction, runtime, arrays and optimizer
pytorch.initialization_scope: PyTorch model construction and FP32 base reconstruction

chunked.rss_scope: Whole isolated process, including model construction, runtime, arrays and optimizer
chunked.initialization_scope: Model construction, differentiation, export and selected execution sessions
chunked.initializer_scope: Logical top-level initializer bytes for each execution session
chunked.input_view_scope: Host data-input preparation; adapter preparation is included in forward
chunked.exchange_scope: CPU NumPy input views; input snapshots and parameter/output views are included in execution boundaries

joint.rss_scope: Whole isolated process, including model construction, runtime, arrays and optimizer
joint.initialization_scope: Model construction, differentiation, export and selected execution sessions
joint.initializer_scope: Logical top-level initializer bytes for each execution session
joint.input_view_scope: Host data/adapter preparation and validation; runtime transfers are included in execution

public_session_payload_bytes.scope: Logical NumPy session arguments and results; excludes internal EP transfers

joint.timing_scope: Forward computes loss and gradients; PyTorch backward scales returned gradients
joint.exchange_scope: CPU NumPy input views; input snapshots and parameter/output views are included in execution boundaries

memory_observation_scope: Isolated whole benchmark processes; physical footprint sampled with vmmap every 15 seconds, peak RSS from the benchmark process

loss_implementation.pytorch: PyTorch standard causal mean cross entropy
loss_implementation.raw: PyTorch standard causal mean cross entropy over ONNX logits
loss_implementation.optimized: PyTorch standard causal mean cross entropy over ONNX logits
loss_implementation.chunked: Target-excluded stable ONNX mean cross entropy in 128-row chunks
loss_implementation.joint: Target-excluded stable ONNX summed cross entropy divided by valid targets
